summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Vanguard Russell 2000 Value ETF (VTWV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 2000 Value index. The fund is passively managed to hold US small-cap value stocks. Holdings are selected and weighted based on price-to-book-value. VTWV was launched on Sep 20, 2010 and is issued by Vanguard.

holdings.infoBox: VTWV is an equity ETF with a total of 1432 individual holdings. The top holdings are Viasat stock at 0.73%, Cytokinetics at 0.65%, UMB Financial at 0.62%, CareTrust REIT at 0.59%, and Terex at 0.54%.
